items.transcript: As someone who spent the last nine years cleaning houses for other people, yes, I was a housekeeper, I'm going to give you my biggest cleaning tip. Let's go. Stop mopping your bathroom floors with the mop you use to mop the rest of your house. In my opinion, it's just not sanitary. I recommend using a bucket and the two-towel method. That means one towel is always wet and the other towel remains dry so that you can dry your floors. And remember, you don't have to do this on your knees. You can use like a sweeper mop to help you out. And for this, I like to use my favorite cleaning recipe, which I will leave you right here, but it's also inside my e-book, which I have for sale.

items.caption:
Boiling water for mopping is an extreme measure that you should only be doing once in awhile when your floors are nasty and only if you have tile floors. laminate, wood, vinyl, or marble you cannot use boiling water to clean your floors. Not only will you be messing up your floors but your mop will be messed up. It is so unnecessary! Warm water is just fine.
